Contributor: Anas masuris Discussion Comment No.: 19 Comment: So, there exists no rule, that says that "the track having entry signals must be tagged with usage=*" and yet you say that it is a must based on exemplary graphic... Mhm. Sorry, but this is not a rule which has been agreed on, but only your interpretation. The only things stated on this page are: * The key usage=* is used to identify the primary usage of a railway track * Inside a railway station area, use usage=main or usage=branch only for the main tracks (not for siding, yard tracks etc.) It may be true for German railways (Still there are non-compliant examples in DE as well, but hush hush), but it doesn't imply automatically that in other countries it is 1:1, given how different regulations and classification is. So the only thing I have to say is to follow the other countries tagging schemes, not reflecting the German one Date: 2026-03-15T19:55:10+01:00
